memory.scope: Peak sampled sum of the caller-selected owned root and observed descendants. A Node root includes its browser and native children; a Python worker root excludes its unrelated browser/Node parent. 250ms sampling can miss short-lived children. GPU and unrelated-process memory are excluded; per-process OS peaks are separate.

memory.scope: Peak sampled sum of the caller-selected owned root and observed descendants. A Node root includes its browser and native children; a Python worker root excludes its unrelated browser/Node parent. 250ms sampling can miss short-lived children. GPU and unrelated-process memory are excluded; per-process OS peaks are separate.

completed_runs.scope: Full Windows WebKit phone-emulation suite after source-dialog focus, enhanced-reader and perspective-correction capability guards, plus portable PDF/camera/blur/pointer fixtures. Real synthetic basic OCR and PDF flows; no private uploads. Explicit unsupported-capability skips are not passes. The isolation test waits for both saved drafts, and extra breakpoint coverage uses the mobile capability rather than a fixed project name.
completed_runs.capability_scope: Synthetic video-stream cases and enhanced OCR implementation cases skip when their actual required browser APIs are absent. Missing/denied camera fallback and a new unsupported-enhanced-to-actual-basic-OCR regression run. No absent API is mocked into an extraction success.
